protocol.corpus: 10 frozen public-team current-M-C inputs, failure-focused rather than a random user sample
protocol.review: All paragraphs and recommendation titles/reasons manually checked; concerns and private audit errors tracked separately
protocol.gate: No increase in confirmed public-error responses on affected inputs and no meaningful loss of critical strategy explanations; scope rollback allowed
protocol.facts: Only existing canonical mechanics linked to selected owners; no new battle facts, schema or reasoning changes
protocol.controls: Common/scope/locale prose and SDK settings identical; only wire encoding/data layout differs
